name: AlphaPing
notes: Risk curator that operates vaults on Morpho, Euler, TermMax, IPOR. No own protocol contracts and no public AlphaPing-specific indexer; their vault positions are indexed by the host protocols' own subgraphs (e.g. Morpho).

name: Mainstreet
notes: Mainstreet-Labs org has only mainstreet-core (Solidity contracts), an audit repo, and a Python proof-of-reserves. No subgraph/Ponder/indexer repo found.

name: Railgun

repos.scope: RAILGUN V3 events (Shield/Unshield/Transact) across Ethereum, Polygon, BSC, Arbitrum
repos.verified: Repo contains subgraph.yaml + schema.graphql + ABIs + Matchstick tests; networks.json defines railgun-v3-ethereum/polygon/bsc/arbitrum deployments indexing RAILGUN smart contracts. ~7 commits, low activity.
Listed in Railgun-Community org as RAILGUN v2 event indexing template alongside v3 template.
Official Railgun-Community repo described as Subsquid indexing platform integration.

notes: Official Railgun-Community org maintains The Graph subgraph templates (v2 + v3) and a Subsquid integration indexing RAILGUN privacy contracts on Ethereum/Arbitrum/BSC/Polygon (matches protocol chains).

name: Bybit Staked SOL
notes: Solana-only CEX-operated LST (Bybit Web3). Custodial, no public EVM-style indexer or open-source repo.

name: SoSoValue Indexes
notes: Centralized crypto index product (SSI). No public protocol repo or indexer found.

name: River Omni-CDP
notes: River (Satoshi-Protocol org) has satoshi-core (CDP contracts), satoshi-farm, satoshi-sdk (TS) and audit repo. No subgraph/Ponder/indexer repo; satoshi-sdk reads on-chain state directly rather than via a public indexer.

name: infiniFi
notes: InfiniFi-Labs org has infinifi-protocol (Solidity) plus various Pendle/Ethena adapter forks and DefiLlama adapters. 'railway-monorepo' is labeled a pre-existing indexer from Revest, not an infiniFi-specific indexer. No dedicated public subgraph/indexer for infiniFi found.

name: Nexus Mutual
notes: NexusMutual org has smart-contracts, sdk, cover-router, dune-queries (Dune SQL analytics), but no The Graph subgraph / Ponder / SubQuery / Subsquid indexer repo. Data tooling is Dune-based + SDK reading chain state.
